name: SY1
author: fenderberg
tagline: A two-part polysynth with 256 Synth1 presets
description: SY1 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a two-oscillator virtual-analog polysynth with Synth1's 99 parameters: it loads .sy1 patches sent over USB, and every parameter can be edited on the FM-1 itself. Bitimbral mode plays two sounds at once: layered, split to the two outputs, or on two MIDI channels. Includes 256 community factory presets, sorted into eight categories, without using the 1,024 user slots. Explore 3,174 community presets in the website Patch Manager or import your own banks locally.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp. The parameter laws are oxo_synth2's measurements of Synth1 (MIT, Francois Chabloz). Not affiliated with Daichi Laboratory.
